products.title: Second Skin Barrier Cream
products.body_html:
Did you know that babies are born with an underdeveloped skin barrier that does not fully mature until they are around 3–4 years old?

Our skin barrier is made up of hardened skin cells (corneocytes) and lipids. The skin cells act like “bricks,” while the lipids are the “cement” that seals up the gaps between the skin cells.

A baby's skin does not produce enough “cement”, and this causes gaps in between their skin cells. Through these gaps, germs and bacteria can easily enter their skin, causing inflammation and flare ups. 

This is why babies are so prone to acne, eczema and other skin issues.

Second Skin is a barrier cream that provides the “cement” baby’s skin is missing. It helps to seal the gaps and make it harder for germs and bacteria to enter the skin. 

The result: clearer, healthier-looking baby skin within 2–4 weeks of use.

products.title: True Belly Serum
products.body_html:
Most stretch mark products like belly butters, creams and lotions simply do not work.

While these products may help to moisturize your skin, they do not penetrate deep enough to help prevent stretch marks, which happens at the dermis or middle layer of our skin.

The True Belly Serum was specially formulated to absorb into the deeper layers of our skin and boost skin elasticity at the dermis layer, effectively reducing the risk of stretch marks and loose skin.

The True Belly Serum contains Centella Asiatica and Triple-Weighted Hyaluronic Acid, ingredients which have been shown in clinical studies to help prevent stretch marks, and are recommended by the American Academy of Dermatology.

Its essential oil is also rich in molecules which support skin cell turnover and has strong anti-aging properties — which is why it is used today in many high-end cosmetic products. 

What most people don’t know is that this precious essential oil is also effective in soothing dry, irritated skin and improving our skin’s natural elasticity! 

This is why Immortelle Essential Oil is one of the key ingredient in our Overnight Nourishing Balm. 

Simply apply a thin layer of Overnight Nourishing Balm onto your baby bump before bed, and wake up to soft, supple skin.
